subject: High-touch onramp exception approval needed for MediFuse pilot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Whelan <tom.whelan@medifuse.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@medifuse.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal and ask: pilot pricing + onramp structure

Tom/Sara —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, MediFuse Health is ready to run a 3-month clinical ML pilot (MAAP integration) across two hospitals. The key asks from your side are: 1) a reduced onramp rate for the pilot months, 2) committed support hours for integration, and 3) an option to scale to a reserved Dedicated pool if pilot metrics hit thresholds.

Attached is the updated plan (MediFuse_MAAP_pricing_plan_v3.pdf) and a draft SOW. Quick summary of proposed commercial terms:
- Pilot pricing: 60% list for first 3 months (token-based + support credit)
- Integration: 40 hours of dedicated SE time included in pilot fee; additional hours billed at discounted rate
- Conversion: 12-month reserved capacity discount tier if committed after pilot

Our ask internally: we need VP/CFO sign-off on a one-time onramp exception (60% of list) because this customer is strategic for our clinical pathway play and could lead to multi-region Dedicated contracts. I have baked in a performance hurdle (30% month-over-month usage growth and successful FHIR ingestion for the first hospital) to trigger conversion incentives.

Can Marissa/Naomi/Karthik weigh in on approval and any suggested guardrails (revenue protection language, conversion SLA, or escrow for credits)? Tom/Sara — we owe you a formalized exception memo if we get approval.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0178

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Whelan <tom.whelan@medifuse.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: pilot pricing + onramp structure

Priyom —

High level: I am open to an onramp exception for strategic healthcare pilots, provided we hardwire conversion language and a cap on lifetime credits. Two immediate asks from finance:
1) Replace the blanket 60% with a blended ARR-weighted discount for the pilot components (e.g., compute vs. support). We need to ensure token-heavy evaluation work isn't subsidized indefinitely.
2) Add a converter clause: if they convert to a 12-month reserved contract within 90 days post-pilot, we amortize a defined portion of credits; otherwise credits expire.

Please draft a one-page exception memo I can present to CFO with: rationale, expected ARR if converted, worst-case revenue impact, guardrails, and sign-off path (VP + CFO).

-Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: pilot pricing + onramp structure

Marissa —

Thanks — attaching a concise exception memo and an ARR/impact worksheet. Key numbers:
- If converted at proposed tier, estimated ARR = $1.2M (conservative)
- Worst-case revenue concession (no conversion) = $48k net (pilot fees + credited support)
- Guardrails proposed: credits expire 45 days after pilot, usage caps per day to avoid burst billing exposure, automatic fallback to lowest-compatible model if usage spikes beyond agreed thresholds.

Attached: MediFuse_MAAP_pricing_plan_v3.pdf; SOW-draft-MediFuse.docx; Exception_Memo_MediFuse_v1.pdf (inline summary below).

Priyom

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Whelan <tom.whelan@medifuse.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: pilot pricing + onramp structure

Priyom/Marissa —

Reviewed the memo. Finance is comfortable advancing this to CFO with the following updates:
- Split the 60% into 50% compute / 80% support credit so we protect token economics while making onboarding cheap from a services perspective.
- Add a clause that any usage beyond the pilot cap is billed at list unless pre-authorized; include a provisional overage holdback of $10k to mitigate abuse.
- Require an executed SOW and PO before pilot start; credits apply only after full payment receipt.

Karthik — please confirm legal redlines on the converter clause (amortization of credits on sign-up). If approved, Marissa will route to CFO for formal sign-off.

-Naomi
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Whelan <tom.whelan@medifuse.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@medifuse.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 17:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal and ask: pilot pricing + onramp structure

All —

Legal reviewed the converter language and proposed small edits: make the amortization schedule explicit (credits amortized monthly over the first 6 months of the reserved contract) and add a standard escape for regulatory delays (if conversion is delayed >120 days due to hospital approvals, credits extend by a single 30-day grace). Also recommended a short indemnity carveout related to patient PII processing tied to the SOW's data handling annex.

With these edits, Marissa, please escalate to CFO (suggest: Marissa -> CFO -> Head of Partnerships sign-off) — recommend approval path: VP (Marissa) endorsement, Naomi (Finance) sign-off, then CFO final authorization.

Tom/Sara — we will send a redlined SOW and final exception memo by end of day Monday. If you need the pilot to start sooner, let us know and we can discuss a limited starter credit to unblock kickoff while we process approvals.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

---

[Attachments referenced above: MediFuse_MAAP_pricing_plan_v3.pdf (pricing plan), SOW-draft-MediFuse.docx (draft scope & data annex), Exception_Memo_MediFuse_v1.pdf (one-pager for CFO)]
